name: Compute Cluster S71: Outlier Handling
description: Tests: winsorize(lower_limit, upper_limit), nsmallest(n), nlargest(n), boolean_select_number. Cap outliers, identify extreme days, what-if analysis.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S71: Outlier Handling
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
volume = src.v

ret = returns(close)

# === WINSORIZE RETURNS ===
clean_ret = winsorize(lower_limit=0.01, upper_limit=0.99)(ret)

# === NSMALLEST: 10 worst return days ===
worst_mask = nsmallest(n=10)(ret)

# === NLARGEST: 10 best return days ===
best_mask = nlargest(n=10)(ret)

# === WHAT-IF: equity without worst 10 days ===
ret_no_worst = boolean_select_number(worst_mask, 0, ret)
eq_original = agg(ret, AggregationType.Sum)
eq_no_worst = agg(ret_no_worst, AggregationType.Sum)

# === NLARGEST: top volume days ===
vol_spike = nlargest(n=20)(volume)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Raw vs Winsorized Returns',
    category='Outliers',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Raw Return', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Winsorized (1/99)', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(ret, clean_ret))

xy_lines(
    title='Equity: With vs Without 10 Worst Days',
    category='What-If',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Original', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Sans Worst 10', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(eq_original, eq_no_worst))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Return', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='10 Worst Return Days'
    )
)(ret, worst_mask)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Return', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='10 Best Return Days'
    )
)(ret, best_mask)
